integrity: Exact self-contained exhaustive Python standard-library enumeration and mathematical collapse argument; independent mathematical review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the proper nontrivial subgroup order complex of A5 and the natural full S5 conjugation action; rational isotypic decomposition, ordinary quotient homotopy, and integral nonequivariant homotopy. Does not assert integral S5-lattice or equivariant homotopy type. Earlier nonequivariant results are credited.
title: The \(S_5\)-character and orbit circle of the \(A_5\) subgroup order complex
